pr_title: sql/pgwire: add metrics for pgwire cancel requests
pr_body:
fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/76332

Release note (general change): The following metrics were added for
observability of cancellation requests made using the Postgres wire
protocol:
- sql.pgwire_cancel.total
- sql.pgwire_cancel.ignored
- sql.pgwire_cancel.successful

The metrics are all counters. The "ignored" counter is incremented if a
cancel request was ignored due to exceeding the per-node rate limit of
cancel requests.

issue_context.title: sql/pgwire: add metrics for pgwire cancel requests
issue_context.body:
As part of the implementation of the pgwire cancel protocol (https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/75870), we should add new observability metrics.

- Total count of cancellation requests.
- Count of cancellation requests that were ignored due to rate limiting.
- Count of cancellation requests that were successful.

Epic CRDB-7644
